summary: Tuesday sound-and-voice night: our four best Shorts (about 1,150 views each) open on a cast line with the narrator under 22% of the words, the narrator-led ones trail (90-727). Added 6 global topics and 3 proposals (1 adopt, 2 experiments).
why: Cast-first Shorts v-20261021-05, v-20261023-01, v-20261023-02, v-20261024-01: 1,140-1,179 views; narrator-first v-20261021-04, v-20261022-01/02/03: 90-727. The evaluator credits the narrator's voice for Shorts where the cast says 84% of the words. The 25 Oct market list is led by billionaire and money-scale Shorts (2.64M, 2.62M).

findings.title: The cast should carry the story
findings.detail: 4 of 4 cast-first Shorts ~1,150 views vs 0 of 4 narrator-first above 727; proposal cast-voices-the-story (experiment, high).

findings.title: The evaluator ranks the wrong voice
findings.detail: 'voice am_michael' credits the narrator in Shorts where Sharma (am_fenrir) speaks 84% of the words; proposal evaluate-voice-heard (adopt).

findings.title: Cinematic music on three of our four best
findings.detail: 1,164 / 1,166 / 1,179 views, all mystery stories; proposal music-follows-story (experiment, low confidence).

findings.title: Money at scale tops the market again
findings.detail: 'What Can You Buy With $1 to $1 QUADRILLION?' 2.64M at 17,200 views an hour; new topic a-billion-is-250-careers.
